At the fictional Bell Street Repair Room, there are four benches, but only one volunteer handles electrical faults. She comes on alternate Saturdays. A lamp waiting for her may therefore stay on the shelf while a chair, brought in later, goes straight to someone who works with wood. The queue is organized partly by the work required, rather than simply by arrival time.
